purpose: Independent ID-disjoint partial-start-date registry subgroup audit of development-selected phase refinement; not chronological or prospective validation.
eligibility: Pure phase label in canonical PHASE_LABELS; excluded from all original phase splits solely due to unavailable exact start-day precision (missing/invalid start date may also be listed). Historical union already excluded. All selected IDs remain unchanged and never enter fitting/tuning.
selection: Refinement candidate chosen only on original tuning macro-F1 then balanced accuracy then accuracy then frozen model order; original phase_logistic comparator scored identically on this subgroup. No threshold, class regrouping, cohort trimming or model selection by audit scores.
caveat: Different calendar-date reporting subgroup; may differ in era and registry practices. Not evidence of future or pretrial accuracy. Previous exact-date test has already been inspected; no repeated untouched-test claim.
